system.description: A virtual crew member with 3 dots in relevant piloting/technical skills and traits. Each round it has 1 Half Action (Aid Another, or a vehicle action when nobody is piloting) and 1 Reaction; once per scene it may add a Half Action or swap its Half for a Full Action.
system.effect: A virtual crew member with 3 dots in relevant piloting/technical skills and traits. Each round it has 1 Half Action (Aid Another, or a vehicle action when nobody is piloting) and 1 Reaction; once per scene it may add a Half Action or swap its Half for a Full Action.
